carryDraftHelp.message: When you switch, the message you are typing moves to a new chat in the other account.

emptyBody.message: Sign in on claude.ai. Lanes recognizes the account and adds it here.

errorAuthFlow.message: An app is signing in with your Claude account in a tab (for example Claude in Chrome). Try again when it's done.

errorCookiesHidden.message: The browser doesn't show the session cookie to the extension, so accounts can't be switched.

errorNoAccount.message: This account is no longer in the list.

errorNoSession.message: There is no saved session for $1. Sign in again with Add Account.

extensionDescription.message: Switch between Claude accounts in Chrome and Edge with one click. Each account has its own color, and with Lanes installed sessions are kept in the Keychain.

hiddenBody.message: The session cookie is hidden from the extension. Account colors and tab marks still work. To use accounts side by side, give each one its own browser profile.

noneActiveBody.message: Pick an account below or add a new one.

openInLanesHelp.message: Opens this account's Claude app in Lanes ($1).

optionsSubtitle.message: Switch Claude accounts in Chrome and Edge with one click.

privacy1.message: The extension runs only on claude.ai. To recognize an account it reads only the name, e-mail and plan. It doesn't read your chats.

privacy2.message: Each account's session cookies are kept in the macOS Keychain when Lanes is installed, otherwise in the extension's own storage. They are never sent to any server.

privacy3.message: Forgetting an account deletes its saved session too. To end the session on Claude's side, sign out on claude.ai.

settingAutoAddHelp.message: Signing in on claude.ai with an account that isn't listed adds it to the list.

settingFaviconHelp.message: A dot in the account's color on the corner of the Claude icon.

settingStripeHelp.message: A thin bar in the account's color at the top of the page.

settingTitleHelp.message: The account's color and name go in front of the tab title.

shortcutDigits.message: Switch to an account in the list

shortcutMenu.message: Ask about selected text with an account

statusAccountsEmpty.message: An account appears here when you sign in on claude.ai.

statusLanesBody.message: Web accounts with the same e-mail take their name and color from Lanes.

statusNoLanesBody.message: Install and open Lanes. It shares its account list with the extension so names and colors match.

statusSwitchOKBody.message: A switch moves every claude.ai tab in this browser profile to the chosen account.

statusSwitchUnknownBody.message: Open claude.ai once so Lanes can check that switching works.

statusVaultKeychainBody.message: Saved sessions are kept encrypted in the macOS Keychain.

statusVaultLocal.message: Sessions are kept in the browser

statusVaultLocalBody.message: The Lanes app couldn't be reached, so sessions are in the extension's own storage for now. Install Lanes 1.1 or later and open it once to move them to the Keychain.

tipBody.message: A browser profile has one Claude account signed in at a time. To use two side by side, add a second Chrome or Edge profile and install the extension there too. Claude in Chrome keeps its own sign-in and isn't affected by switching.
